source: NASA PDS / SPDF CDAWeb, MSL_RAD_OBS-L2, variable DOSIMETRY_TOTAL_f (quality filtered)
quantity: Absorbed dose rate in tissue-equivalent plastic (detector E), TOTAL_DOSE_E
not: Absorbed dose, NOT dose equivalent (mSv). Measured inside the rover's environment, not on a person.

reference.label: Measured by Curiosity RAD (median of the last 30 days with data)

illustrative_budget.label: Illustrative EVA budget = reference rate x EVA duration. Not an estimated human dose: no suit, no body self-shielding, no quality factor.

alert.label: Illustrative alert (assumption): rate above 3 x reference

climatology.label: Hourly mean dose rate by calendar day and UTC hour, over all years with data (historical).
climatology.hour_axis: UTC (RAD timestamps; not Mars local time)

solar_event.label: Historical scenario: what RAD measured during the 2024-05-20 solar particle event. Not a prediction.
